about: Argument values valid on one side only, as (callable, parameter, value, side), hand-mined from the release notes on 2026-10-15. `replacement` is the other side's spelling where the notes give one; `anchored` also matches the anchored forms (Q-JUN, A-DEC). Each record is a claim until `varag bench probe` confirms it in the environments (`probe`).
